The '''Exploration Cave''' was an underwater cave located within the [[Exploration Dome]] on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], the entire Exploration Dome and the cave itself were taken over by the [[Syphus Collective]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bodan Siraam]] was eventually killed in the cave.<ref name="TOR:Fallout" />
